description: Role-based temporal sampling policy for the authoritative structural-worlds-v1 relationships. It introduces time ordering and held-out trajectory seeds without restating any world-specific relationship, target, observation map, or identifiability semantics.
interpretation_boundary: Temporal processes are synthetic controls attached to latent roles by the existing world authority. They do not redefine static world truth, imply causal climate dynamics, or turn a static non-identifiability declaration into a dynamical identifiability claim.
